content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Richland

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your PMP Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your background—typically a bachelor's degree plus project experience, or an associate degree with additional hours. Gather transcripts and project records before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend synchronous sessions from your location in Richland on a schedule that fits your work at PNNL, Hanford Site support contractors, or regional healthcare and energy employers. Active certified practitioners lead all instruction.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the 35-hour course, submit your official PMP application to PMI with transcripts, work history, and proof of training hours. Pay PMI's examination fee. PMI will verify your credentials and grant eligibility to sit for the exam within a defined window.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Test for the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence in the PMP exam's format and domains. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE. Test from home or an approved proctoring center and complete the 4-hour, computer-based assessment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, your PMP credential is valid for three years. Within that cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) by attending approved training, conferences, or project management work. Submit your renewal application and fee to PMI before expiration to maintain active status in your career.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
